channel.title: Gurbani Soul — Learn
channel.description: Plain, sourced explanations of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji from Gurbani Soul — verbatim scripture, cited by Ang.

item.title: How the daily Hukamnama is verified
item.description: How Gurbani Soul finds each day's Hukamnama in its own verified text, proves it word for word, and holds what fails.

item.title: Hukamnama corrections log
item.description: Every day the Hukamnama on Gurbani Soul was corrected or held, with what happened and why.

item.title: What is a Hukamnama?
item.description: What a Hukamnama is, the daily Hukamnama from Sri Harmandir Sahib, and how it differs from the app's Hukam of the day.

item.title: How to read Nitnem
item.description: The daily banis of Nitnem by time of day, and how Gurbani Soul keeps your place and offers gentle reminders you set yourself.

item.title: The 31 raags and the watches of the day
item.description: How Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji is arranged by raag, what the pahars or watches of the day are, and what the Raag Clock shows.

item.title: What is an Ang?
item.description: Why the pages of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji are called Angs, how the 1,430 Angs are numbered, and why quotes cite the Ang.

item.title: How Gurbani Soul verifies scripture
item.description: Verbatim extraction, character-for-character reconciliation, and the SHA-256 checksum that guards the bundled scripture.

item.title: Search by first letters
item.description: How first-letter search works in Gurbani Soul, alongside search by word, by sound in Roman letters, and by theme.

item.title: Offline and private by design
item.description: Why Gurbani Soul works offline, keeps no account, never sees what you read, and collects one thing only if you ask.

item.title: Widgets and Live Activity
item.description: The Home Screen widgets, the reading Live Activity that never shows a verse, and how Siri and Shortcuts fit in.
